sources.timestampBasis: Official Maryland State Board of Elections 2024 Presidential General Election raw precinct data file; downloaded June 29, 2026.
sources.confidence: Official statewide raw precinct CSV. Rows include county, election district-precinct, office, candidate, party, winner/write-in markers, and early, election-night, mail-in, provisional, and second mail-in vote columns. President and U.S. Senate rows reconcile at the same 1,958 local reporting units.

sources.timestampBasis: Official Maryland State Board of Elections 2020 General Election county result CSVs; downloaded July 9, 2026.
sources.confidence: Official county and county-equivalent presidential baseline rows normalized by scripts/normalize-md-historical-baseline.mjs from data/md-2020-general-county-results/*.csv and reconciled to data/md-2020-general-statewide.csv. Baltimore City and Baltimore County are mapped only from distinct official files and Census GEOIDs.

reviewCharts.warning: Maryland review rows use official State Board of Elections precinct-level President-versus-U.S.-Senate comparisons. The precinct CSV includes ballot-mode columns, but no same-row registered-voter denominator; turnout remains EAC jurisdiction fallback until a state-native denominator source is collected. Precinct boundary geometry is not included.

turnout.notes: Maryland turnout rows use EAC 2024 V2 county/jurisdiction fallback rows until a state-native turnout denominator artifact is collected.

historicalBaselines.warning: Maryland historical baseline rows are official 2020 State Board of Elections county and county-equivalent presidential rows. Use them as contextual baselines only, not as 2024 certified data. The statewide County=00 row is retained only for reconciliation and is not emitted as a jurisdiction row.
